title: Your Stomach Gets a New Lining Every Few Days
description: Your stomach replaces the cells of its inner lining every few days to protect itself from its own acid.

scenes.text: Your stomach gives itself a fresh new lining every few days.
That is because stomach acid is strong enough to break down tough food, and it would slowly damage the stomach too.
A thick layer of mucus protects the wall, and the cells underneath are replaced again and again.
Those cells only last a few days before new ones take their place, so the damage never builds up.
Your body is always quietly rebuilding itself. Follow for more weird facts.
